TableList.customQuery: SELECT CONVERT(varchar(20), src.InvoiceID) + 'E1' AS ID, src.InvoiceID AS ORDER_ID, src.InvoiceTag AS TYPE, src.InvoiceType AS RAW_EVENT_TYPE, ISNULL(src.inTimeStamp_StartSale, src.inTimeStamp) AS DATE_TIME, src.inTimeStamp AS END_DATE_TIME, GETDATE() AS UPDATED_DATE_TIME, src.originbranchid AS FULFILLMENT_LOCATION_ID, 'STORE' AS FULFILLMENT_TYPE, src.originbranchid AS STORE_NUMBER, src.TillNumber AS POS_NUMBER, src.staffid AS CASHIER_NUMBER, src.InvoiceID AS TICKET_NUMBER, src.staffid AS SALES_PERSON_ID, NULL AS MANAGER_ID, 0 AS VOIDED_FLAG, SUM(ISNULL(src.ElectronicAmount, 0) + ISNULL(src.CashAmount, 0) + ISNULL(src.ChequeAmount, 0) + ISNULL(src.AccountAmount, 0)) / COUNT(1) AS TICKET_AMOUNT, SUM(ISNULL(src.unitGSTAmount * src.QtySupplied, 0)) AS TICKET_TAX_AMOUNT, CASE WHEN src.CountryCode = 'AUS' THEN 'AUD' WHEN src.CountryCode = 'NZL' THEN 'NZD' ELSE 'NA' END AS CURRENCY_CODE, src.ElectronicType AS ELECTRONIC_TYPE, SUM(ISNULL(src.CashAmount, 0)) / COUNT(1) AS CASH_AMOUNT, SUM(ISNULL(src.ElectronicAmount, 0)) / COUNT(1) AS ELECTRONIC_AMOUNT, SUM(ISNULL(src.ChequeAmount, 0)) / COUNT(1) AS CHEQUE_AMOUNT, SUM(ISNULL(src.AccountAmount, 0)) / COUNT(1) AS ACCOUNT_AMOUNT, SUM(ISNULL(src.CashOutAmount, 0)) / COUNT(1) AS CASH_OUT_AMOUNT FROM (SELECT ti.InvoiceID, Invoice_types.InvoiceTag, ti.InvoiceType, t.inTimeStamp, t.inTimeStamp_StartSale, ti.originbranchid, ti.TillNumber, ti.staffid, t.unitGSTAmount, t.QtySupplied, t.inforstaffid, ti.ElectronicAmount, ti.CashAmount, ti.ChequeAmount, ti.AccountAmount, ti.CashOutAmount, ti.ElectronicType, bi.CountryCode FROM dbo.Transactions t WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN dbo.transactions_invoice ti ON t.invoiceid = ti.InvoiceID INNER JOIN (SELECT invoiceid, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN li.QtySupplied > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = COUNT(li.QtySupplied) THEN 'Purchase' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN li.QtySupplied < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = COUNT(li.QtySupplied) THEN 'Return' ELSE 'Exchange' END AS InvoiceTag FROM dbo.transactions li WHERE li.inTimeStamp >= DATEADD(day, -2, '{{LoadDate}}') AND li.inTimeStamp < DATEADD(day, -1, '{{LoadDate}}') GROUP BY invoiceid) Invoice_types ON ti.InvoiceID = Invoice_types.InvoiceID INNER JOIN dbo.BranchInfoGlobal bi ON t.OriginBranchID = bi.BranchID INNER JOIN dbo.BranchInfoHierarchy bih ON bih.BranchID = bi.BranchID WHERE ((bih.ShopFrontType <> 'Epharmacy' AND bih.ShopFrontType <> 'Exclude' OR bih.ShopFrontType IS NULL) AND bi.BranchID NOT IN (663, 723) AND bi.StoreGroupID <> 0 AND bi.Storename NOT LIKE '%test%' AND bi.Storename NOT LIKE N'(DO NOT USE)%' AND bih.Exclude <> 1 AND bih.OpeningDate IS NOT NULL) AND t.inTimeStamp >= DATEADD(day, -2, '{{LoadDate}}') AND t.inTimeStamp < DATEADD(day, -1, '{{LoadDate}}')) src WHERE ?AdfDynamicRangePartitionCondition GROUP BY src.InvoiceID, src.InvoiceTag, src.InvoiceType, src.inTimeStamp_StartSale, src.inTimeStamp, src.originbranchid, src.TillNumber, src.staffid, src.inforstaffid, src.ElectronicType, src.CountryCode;

SELECT CONVERT(varchar(20), ta.InvoiceID) + 'E1' AS ID, ta.InvoiceID AS ORDER_ID, 'Purchase' AS TYPE, 2 AS RAW_EVENT_TYPE, MIN(ta.TimeStamp) AS DATE_TIME, MAX(ta.TimeStamp) AS END_DATE_TIME, GETDATE() AS UPDATED_DATE_TIME, ta.originbranchid AS FULFILLMENT_LOCATION_ID, 'STORE' AS FULFILLMENT_TYPE, ta.originbranchid AS STORE_NUMBER, ta.MachineName AS POS_NUMBER, SUM(CASE WHEN ta.ActivityID = 27 THEN ta.EnteredBy ELSE 0 END) AS CASHIER_NUMBER, ta.InvoiceID AS TICKET_NUMBER, SUM(CASE WHEN ta.ActivityID = 27 THEN ta.EnteredBy ELSE 0 END) AS SALES_PERSON_ID, NULL AS MANAGER_ID, 1 AS VOIDED_FLAG, NULL AS TICKET_AMOUNT, NULL AS TICKET_TAX_AMOUNT, CASE WHEN bi.CountryCode = 'AUS' THEN 'AUD' WHEN bi.CountryCode = 'NZL' THEN 'NZD' ELSE 'NA' END AS CURRENCY_CODE, NULL AS ELECTRONIC_TYPE, NULL AS CASH_AMOUNT, NULL AS ELECTRONIC_AMOUNT, NULL AS CHEQUE_AMOUNT, NULL AS ACCOUNT_AMOUNT, NULL AS CASH_OUT_AMOUNT FROM TransactionAuditSaleActivityLoghistory ta WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN BranchInfoGlobal bi ON ta.OriginBranchID = bi.BranchID INNER JOIN BranchInfoHierarchy bih ON bih.BranchID = bi.BranchID WHERE ((bih.ShopFrontType <> 'Epharmacy' AND bih.ShopFrontType <> 'Exclude' OR bih.ShopFrontType IS NULL) AND bi.BranchID NOT IN (663, 723) AND bi.StoreGroupID <> 0 AND bi.Storename NOT LIKE '%test%' AND bi.Storename NOT LIKE N'(DO NOT USE)%' AND bih.Exclude <> 1 AND bih.OpeningDate IS NOT NULL) AND ta.InvoiceID IS NOT NULL AND ta.InvoiceID <> -1 AND ta.TimeStamp >= DATEADD(DAY, -2, '{{LoadDate}}') AND ta.TimeStamp < DATEADD(DAY, -1, '{{LoadDate}}') AND ?AdfDynamicRangePartitionCondition AND ta.InvoiceID IN (SELECT DISTINCT t2.InvoiceID FROM TransactionAuditSaleActivityLoghistory t2 WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN BranchInfoGlobal bi2 ON t2.OriginBranchID = bi2.BranchID INNER JOIN BranchInfoHierarchy bih2 ON bih2.BranchID = bi2.BranchID WHERE t2.ActivityID = 27 AND t2.InvoiceID IS NOT NULL AND t2.InvoiceID <> -1 AND ((bih2.ShopFrontType <> 'Epharmacy' AND bih2.ShopFrontType <> 'Exclude' OR bih2.ShopFrontType IS NULL) AND bi2.BranchID NOT IN (663, 723) AND bi2.StoreGroupID <> 0 AND bi2.Storename NOT LIKE '%test%' AND bi2.Storename NOT LIKE N'(DO NOT USE)%' AND bih2.Exclude <> 1 AND bih2.OpeningDate IS NOT NULL) AND t2.TimeStamp >= DATEADD(DAY, -2, '{{LoadDate}}') AND t2.TimeStamp < DATEADD(DAY, -1, '{{LoadDate}}')) GROUP BY ta.InvoiceID, ta.machinename, ta.originbranchid, bi.CountryCode;

SELECT ta.InvoiceID AS ORDER_ID, ta.InvoiceID AS ORDER_NUMBER, MIN(ta.TimeStamp) AS DATE_TIME, MAX(ta.TimeStamp) AS END_DATE_TIME, GETDATE() AS UPDATED_DATE_TIME, 'CANCELLED' AS STATUS, 'STORE' AS CHANNEL, CASE WHEN bi.CountryCode = 'AUS' THEN 'AUD' WHEN bi.CountryCode = 'NZL' THEN 'NZD' ELSE 'NA' END AS CURRENCY_CODE, NULL AS TOTAL_AMOUNT, NULL AS SUBTOTAL_AMOUNT, NULL AS TOTAL_TAX_AMOUNT, 1 AS TOTAL_ITEM_COUNT, NULL AS TOTAL_DISCOUNT_AMOUNT, 1 AS TOTAL_EVENT_COUNT, ta.machinename AS MACHINE_NAME, SUM(CASE WHEN ta.ActivityID = 27 THEN ta.EnteredBy ELSE 0 END) AS STAFF_ID, NULL AS FOR_STAFF_ID, ta.OriginBranchID AS SOURCE_STORE_ID, 0 AS RETURNINVOICEID, NULL AS CASH_CHANGE, NULL AS ORIGINAL_TOTAL, NULL AS CUSTOMER_ID, NULL AS CUSTOMER_FIRST_NAME, NULL AS CUSTOMER_LAST_NAME, NULL AS CUSTOMER_EMAIL, NULL AS CUSTOMER_PHONE FROM TransactionAuditSaleActivityLoghistory ta WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN BranchInfoGlobal bi ON ta.OriginBranchID = bi.BranchID INNER JOIN BranchInfoHierarchy bih ON bih.BranchID = bi.BranchID WHERE ((bih.ShopFrontType <> 'Epharmacy' AND bih.ShopFrontType <> 'Exclude' OR bih.ShopFrontType IS NULL) AND bi.BranchID NOT IN (663, 723) AND bi.StoreGroupID <> 0 AND bi.Storename NOT LIKE '%test%' AND bi.Storename NOT LIKE N'(DO NOT USE)%' AND bih.Exclude <> 1 AND bih.OpeningDate IS NOT NULL) AND ta.InvoiceID IS NOT NULL AND ta.InvoiceID <> -1 AND ta.TimeStamp >= DATEADD(DAY, -2, '{{LoadDate}}') AND ta.TimeStamp < DATEADD(DAY, -1, '{{LoadDate}}') AND ?AdfDynamicRangePartitionCondition AND ta.InvoiceID IN (SELECT DISTINCT t2.InvoiceID FROM TransactionAuditSaleActivityLoghistory t2 WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN BranchInfoGlobal bi2 ON t2.OriginBranchID = bi2.BranchID INNER JOIN BranchInfoHierarchy bih2 ON bih2.BranchID = bi2.BranchID WHERE t2.activityid = 27 AND t2.InvoiceID IS NOT NULL AND t2.InvoiceID <> -1 AND ((bih2.ShopFrontType <> 'Epharmacy' AND bih2.ShopFrontType <> 'Exclude' OR bih2.ShopFrontType IS NULL) AND bi2.BranchID NOT IN (663, 723) AND bi2.StoreGroupID <> 0 AND bi2.Storename NOT LIKE '%test%' AND bi2.Storename NOT LIKE N'(DO NOT USE)%' AND bih2.Exclude <> 1 AND bih2.OpeningDate IS NOT NULL) AND t2.TimeStamp >= DATEADD(DAY, -2, '{{LoadDate}}') AND t2.TimeStamp < DATEADD(DAY, -1, '{{LoadDate}}')) GROUP BY ta.InvoiceID, ta.machinename, ta.EnteredBy, ta.OriginBranchID, bi.CountryCode;

SELECT t.InvoiceID AS ORDER_ID, t.InvoiceID AS ORDER_NUMBER, t.inTimeStamp_StartSale AS DATE_TIME, t.inTimeStamp AS END_DATE_TIME, GETDATE() AS UPDATED_DATE_TIME, 'COMPLETED' AS STATUS, 'STORE' AS CHANNEL, CASE WHEN bi.CountryCode = 'AUS' THEN 'AUD' WHEN bi.CountryCode = 'NZL' THEN 'NZD' ELSE 'NA' END AS CURRENCY_CODE, SUM(t.Total) AS TOTAL_AMOUNT, SUM(t.Total - ISNULL(t.unitGSTAmount * t.QtySupplied, 0)) AS SUBTOTAL_AMOUNT, SUM(ISNULL(t.unitGSTAmount * t.QtySupplied, 0)) AS TOTAL_TAX_AMOUNT, COUNT(1) AS TOTAL_ITEM_COUNT, SUM(ISNULL((t.baseunitpriceex - t.unitpriceex) * t.QtySupplied, 0)) AS TOTAL_DISCOUNT_AMOUNT, 1 AS TOTAL_EVENT_COUNT, t.instoremachinename AS MACHINE_NAME, t.inStaffID AS STAFF_ID, t.inForStaffID AS FOR_STAFF_ID, ti.OriginBranchID AS SOURCE_STORE_ID, MAX(ISNULL(CASE WHEN t.inInvoiceType = 2 AND t.QtySupplied < 0 THEN t.GeneralReferenceID ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS RETURNINVOICEID, SUM(ISNULL(ti.ElectronicAmount, 0) + ISNULL(ti.CashAmount, 0) + ISNULL(ti.ChequeAmount, 0) + ISNULL(ti.AccountAmount, 0) + ISNULL(ti.GiftCardAmount, 0)) / COUNT(1) - SUM(t.Total) AS CASH_CHANGE, SUM(ISNULL(ti.ElectronicAmount, 0) + ISNULL(ti.CashAmount, 0) + ISNULL(ti.ChequeAmount, 0) + ISNULL(ti.AccountAmount, 0) + ISNULL(ti.GiftCardAmount, 0)) / COUNT(1) AS ORIGINAL_TOTAL, NULL AS CUSTOMER_ID, NULL AS CUSTOMER_FIRST_NAME, NULL AS CUSTOMER_LAST_NAME, NULL AS CUSTOMER_EMAIL, NULL AS CUSTOMER_PHONE FROM Transactions AS t WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN (SELECT InvoiceID AS InvoiceID_ti, OriginBranchID, ElectronicAmount, CashAmount, ChequeAmount, AccountAmount, GiftCardAmount FROM transactions_invoice) AS ti ON t.InvoiceID = ti.InvoiceID_ti INNER JOIN BranchInfoGlobal bi ON t.OriginBranchID = bi.BranchID INNER JOIN BranchInfoHierarchy bih ON bih.BranchID = bi.BranchID WHERE ((bih.ShopFrontType <> 'Epharmacy' AND bih.ShopFrontType <> 'Exclude' OR bih.ShopFrontType IS NULL) AND bi.BranchID NOT IN (663, 723) AND bi.StoreGroupID <> 0 AND bi.Storename NOT LIKE '%test%' AND bi.Storename NOT LIKE N'(DO NOT USE)%' AND bih.Exclude <> 1 AND bih.OpeningDate IS NOT NULL) AND t.inTimeStamp >= DATEADD(DAY, -2, '{{LoadDate}}') AND t.inTimeStamp < DATEADD(DAY, -1, '{{LoadDate}}') AND ?AdfDynamicRangePartitionCondition GROUP BY t.InvoiceID, t.inTimeStamp_StartSale, t.inTimeStamp, t.instoremachinename, t.inStaffID, t.inForStaffID, ti.OriginBranchID, bi.CountryCode;

SELECT CONVERT(varchar(50), ta.InvoiceID) + 'T1' AS ID, ta.InvoiceID AS ORDER_ID, 1 AS SEQUENCE, 'OTHER' AS TYPE, NULL AS AMOUNT, CASE WHEN bi.CountryCode = 'AUS' THEN 'AUD' WHEN bi.CountryCode = 'NZL' THEN 'NZD' ELSE 'NA' END AS CURRENCY_CODE, NULL AS CARD_EXPIRATION_DATE, NULL AS AUTHORIZED_FLAG, 'True' AS VOIDED_FLAG, NULL AS CASH_BACK_AMOUNT, NULL AS PAYMENT_GATEWAY, NULL AS AUTHORIZATION_CODE, NULL AS SETTLEMENT_ID, 'OTHER' AS CARD_TYPE, NULL AS CARD_NUMBER, 'CARDHOLDER' AS CARDHOLDER_NAME, NULL AS BIN, NULL AS CARD_NUMBER_LAST4, NULL AS AVS_CHECK, NULL AS CVV_CHECK, NULL AS ELECTRONIC_RECEIPT, NULL AS ELECTRONIC_TYPE, NULL AS STATUS, NULL AS GIFT_BALANCE, GETDATE() AS UPDATED_DATE_TIME FROM dbo.TransactionAuditSaleActivityLoghistory ta WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN dbo.BranchInfoGlobal bi WITH (NOLOCK) ON ta.OriginBranchID = bi.BranchID INNER JOIN dbo.BranchInfoHierarchy bih WITH (NOLOCK) ON bih.BranchID = bi.BranchID WHERE ((bih.ShopFrontType <> 'Epharmacy' AND bih.ShopFrontType <> 'Exclude' OR bih.ShopFrontType IS NULL) AND bi.BranchID NOT IN (663, 723) AND bi.StoreGroupID <> 0 AND bi.Storename NOT LIKE '%test%' AND bi.Storename NOT LIKE N'(DO NOT USE)%' AND bih.Exclude <> 1 AND bih.OpeningDate IS NOT NULL) AND ta.ActivityID = 27 AND ta.InvoiceID IS NOT NULL AND ta.InvoiceID <> -1 AND ta.TimeStamp >= DATEADD(day, -2, '{{LoadDate}}') AND ta.TimeStamp < DATEADD(day, -1, '{{LoadDate}}') AND ?AdfDynamicRangePartitionCondition;

WITH inv AS ( SELECT ti.*, bi.CountryCode FROM transactions_invoice ti INNER JOIN BranchInfoGlobal bi ON ti.OriginBranchID = bi.BranchID INNER JOIN BranchInfoHierarchy bih ON bih.BranchID = bi.BranchID WHERE ( (bih.ShopFrontType <> 'Epharmacy' AND bih.ShopFrontType <> 'Exclude' OR bih.ShopFrontType IS NULL) AND bi.BranchID NOT IN (663, 723) AND bi.StoreGroupID <> 0 AND bi.Storename NOT LIKE '%test%' AND bi.Storename NOT LIKE N'(DO NOT USE)%' AND bih.Exclude <> 1 AND bih.OpeningDate IS NOT NULL ) AND ti.[TimeStamp] >= DATEADD(DAY, -2, '{{LoadDate}}') AND ti.[TimeStamp] < DATEADD(DAY, -1, '{{LoadDate}}') AND ?AdfDynamicRangePartitionCondition ), ep AS ( SELECT InvoiceID AS EP_INVOICEID, ElectronicPaymentID, ElectronicAmount, Success, ApprovedCode, CardType, ElectronicRef, ElectronicRef_LeadingChars, ElectronicReceipt, ElectronicType, GiftBalance FROM Transactions_ElectronicPayments ) SELECT CONVERT(varchar(50), ti.InvoiceID) + 'T' + CONVERT(varchar(50), COALESCE(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ti.InvoiceID ORDER BY p.ElectronicPaymentID), 0)) AS ID, ti.InvoiceID AS ORDER_ID, COALESCE(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ti.InvoiceID ORDER BY p.ElectronicPaymentID), 0) AS SEQUENCE, CASE WHEN ti.ElectronicAmount <> 0 AND (p.ElectronicType <> 'GIVEX' OR p.ElectronicType IS NULL) AND UPPER(p.ElectronicType) <> 'CHEQUE' THEN 'CREDIT' WHEN ti.ElectronicAmount <> 0 AND p.CardType = 'DEBIT' THEN 'DEBIT' WHEN ti.ChequeAmount > 0 THEN 'CHEQUE' WHEN ti.AccountAmount > 0 THEN 'ACCOUNT' WHEN ti.GiftCardAmount > 0 AND p.ElectronicType = 'GIVEX' THEN 'GIFT_CARD' ELSE 'OTHER' END AS [TYPE], ISNULL(p.ElectronicAmount, (ISNULL(ti.CashAmount,0) + ISNULL(ti.ChequeAmount,0) + ISNULL(ti.AccountAmount,0) + ISNULL(ti.GiftCardAmount,0))) AS AMOUNT, CASE WHEN ti.CountryCode = 'AUS' THEN 'AUD' WHEN ti.CountryCode = 'NZL' THEN 'NZD' ELSE 'NA' END AS CURRENCY_CODE, CASE WHEN ti.ChequeAmount > 0 THEN NULL WHEN ti.AccountAmount > 0 THEN NULL ELSE '12/99' END AS CARD_EXPIRATION_DATE, p.Success AS AUTHORIZED_FLAG, 'False' AS VOIDED_FLAG, ti.CashOutAmount AS CASH_BACK_AMOUNT, CASE WHEN p.ElectronicPaymentID IS NOT NULL THEN 'EFTPOS' ELSE NULL END AS PAYMENT_GATEWAY, p.ApprovedCode AS AUTHORIZATION_CODE, p.ElectronicPaymentID AS SETTLEMENT_ID, p.CardType AS CARD_TYPE, p.ElectronicRef AS CARD_NUMBER, CASE WHEN ti.ChequeAmount > 0 THEN NULL WHEN ti.AccountAmount > 0 THEN NULL ELSE 'CARDHOLDER' END AS CARDHOLDER_NAME, p.ElectronicRef_LeadingChars AS BIN, CASE WHEN ISNUMERIC(SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING(p.[ElectronicReceipt], CHARINDEX('###########', p.[ElectronicReceipt]) + 8, 12), PATINDEX('%[0-9]%', SUBSTRING(p.[ElectronicReceipt], CHARINDEX('###########', p.[ElectronicReceipt]) + 8, 12)), 4)) = 0 THEN SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING(p.[ElectronicReceipt], CHARINDEX('....', p.[ElectronicReceipt]) + 4, 12), PATINDEX('%[0-9]%', SUBSTRING(p.[ElectronicReceipt], CHARINDEX('....', p.[ElectronicReceipt]) + 4, 12)), 4) ELSE SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING(p.[ElectronicReceipt], CHARINDEX('###########', p.[ElectronicReceipt]) + 8, 12), PATINDEX('%[0-9]%', SUBSTRING(p.[ElectronicReceipt], CHARINDEX('###########', p.[ElectronicReceipt]) + 8, 12)), 4) END AS CARD_NUMBER_LAST4, CASE WHEN ti.ChequeAmount > 0 THEN NULL WHEN ti.AccountAmount > 0 THEN NULL ELSE 'Y' END AS AVS_CHECK, CASE WHEN ti.ChequeAmount > 0 THEN NULL WHEN ti.AccountAmount > 0 THEN NULL ELSE 'M' END AS CVV_CHECK, p.ElectronicReceipt AS ELECTRONIC_RECEIPT, p.ElectronicType AS ELECTRONIC_TYPE, CASE WHEN p.Success = 1 THEN 'Success' WHEN p.Success = 0 THEN 'Failed' ELSE NULL END AS STATUS, p.GiftBalance AS GIFT_BALANCE, GETDATE() AS UPDATED_DATE_TIME FROM inv ti LEFT JOIN ep p ON ti.InvoiceID = p.EP_InvoiceID WHERE ISNULL(ti.cashamount, 0) = 0 AND ISNULL(ti.Chequeamount, 0) = 0 AND ISNULL(ti.accountamount, 0) = 0 UNION ALL SELECT CONVERT(varchar(50), ti.InvoiceID) + 'T' + CONVERT(varchar(50), COALESCE(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ti.InvoiceID ORDER BY p.ElectronicPaymentID), 0)) AS ID, ti.InvoiceID AS ORDER_ID, COALESCE(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ti.InvoiceID ORDER BY p.ElectronicPaymentID), 0) AS SEQUENCE, CASE WHEN ti.ElectronicAmount > 0 AND (p.ElectronicType <> 'GIVEX' OR p.ElectronicType IS NULL) AND UPPER(p.ElectronicType) <> 'CHEQUE' THEN 'CREDIT' WHEN p.ElectronicAmount > 0 AND p.CardType = 'DEBIT' THEN 'DEBIT' WHEN ti.ChequeAmount > 0 THEN 'CHEQUE' WHEN (ti.GiftCardAmount > 0 OR p.ElectronicAmount < 0) AND p.ElectronicType = 'GIVEX' THEN 'GIFT_CARD' ELSE 'CREDIT' END AS [TYPE], ISNULL(p.ElectronicAmount, ISNULL(ti.ElectronicAmount, 0)) AS AMOUNT, CASE WHEN ti.CountryCode = 'AUS' THEN 'AUD' WHEN ti.CountryCode = 'NZL' THEN 'NZD' ELSE 'NA' END AS CURRENCY_CODE, CASE WHEN ti.ChequeAmount > 0 THEN NULL WHEN ti.AccountAmount > 0 THEN NULL ELSE '12/99' END AS CARD_EXPIRATION_DATE, p.Success AS AUTHORIZED_FLAG, 'False' AS VOIDED_FLAG, ti.CashOutAmount AS CASH_BACK_AMOUNT, CASE WHEN p.ElectronicPaymentID IS NOT NULL THEN 'EFTPOS' ELSE NULL END AS PAYMENT_GATEWAY, p.ApprovedCode AS AUTHORIZATION_CODE, p.ElectronicPaymentID AS SETTLEMENT_ID, p.CardType AS CARD_TYPE, p.ElectronicRef AS CARD_NUMBER, CASE WHEN ti.ChequeAmount > 0 THEN NULL WHEN ti.AccountAmount > 0 THEN NULL ELSE 'CARDHOLDER' END AS CARDHOLDER_NAME, p.ElectronicRef_LeadingChars AS BIN, CASE WHEN ISNUMERIC(SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING(p.[ElectronicReceipt], CHARINDEX('###########', p.[ElectronicReceipt]) + 8, 12), PATINDEX('%[0-9]%', SUBSTRING(p.[ElectronicReceipt], CHARINDEX('###########', p.[ElectronicReceipt]) + 8, 12)), 4)) = 0 THEN SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING(p.[ElectronicReceipt], CHARINDEX('....', p.[ElectronicReceipt]) + 4, 12), PATINDEX('%[0-9]%', SUBSTRING(p.[ElectronicReceipt], CHARINDEX('....', p.[ElectronicReceipt]) + 4, 12)), 4) ELSE SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING(p.[ElectronicReceipt], CHARINDEX('###########', p.[ElectronicReceipt]) + 8, 12), PATINDEX('%[0-9]%', SUBSTRING(p.[ElectronicReceipt], CHARINDEX('###########', p.[ElectronicReceipt]) + 8, 12)), 4) END AS CARD_NUMBER_LAST4, 'Y' AS AVS_CHECK, 'M' AS CVV_CHECK, p.ElectronicReceipt AS ELECTRONIC_RECEIPT, p.ElectronicType AS ELECTRONIC_TYPE, CASE WHEN p.Success = 1 THEN 'Success' WHEN p.Success = 0 THEN 'Failed' ELSE NULL END AS STATUS, p.GiftBalance AS GIFT_BALANCE, GETDATE() AS UPDATED_DATE_TIME FROM inv ti LEFT JOIN ep p ON ti.InvoiceID = p.EP_InvoiceID WHERE ISNULL(ti.cashamount, 0) + ISNULL(AccountAmount, 0) + ISNULL(chequeamount, 0) <> 0 AND (ISNULL(ti.ElectronicAmount, ISNULL(p.ElectronicAmount, 0)) + ISNULL(ti.GiftCardAmount, 0)) <> 0 UNION ALL SELECT CONVERT(varchar(50), ti.InvoiceID) + 'T' + '0' AS ID, ti.InvoiceID AS ORDER_ID, 0 AS SEQUENCE, 'CASH' AS [TYPE], ISNULL(ti.CashAmount, 0) AS AMOUNT, CASE WHEN ti.CountryCode = 'AUS' THEN 'AUD' WHEN ti.CountryCode = 'NZL' THEN 'NZD' ELSE 'NA' END AS CURRENCY_CODE, NULL AS CARD_EXPIRATION_DATE, NULL AS AUTHORIZED_FLAG, 'False' AS VOIDED_FLAG, ti.CashOutAmount AS CASH_BACK_AMOUNT, NULL AS PAYMENT_GATEWAY, NULL AS AUTHORIZATION_CODE, NULL AS SETTLEMENT_ID, NULL AS CARD_TYPE, NULL AS CARD_NUMBER, NULL AS CARDHOLDER_NAME, NULL AS BIN, NULL AS CARD_NUMBER_LAST4, NULL AS AVS_CHECK, NULL AS CVV_CHECK, NULL AS ELECTRONIC_RECEIPT, NULL AS ELECTRONIC_TYPE, NULL AS STATUS, NULL AS GIFT_BALANCE, GETDATE() AS UPDATED_DATE_TIME FROM inv ti WHERE ti.CashAmount <> 0 UNION ALL SELECT CONVERT(varchar(50), ti.InvoiceID) + 'T' + 'A0' AS ID, ti.InvoiceID AS ORDER_ID, 0 AS SEQUENCE, 'ACCOUNT' AS [TYPE], ISNULL(ti.AccountAmount, 0) AS AMOUNT, CASE WHEN ti.CountryCode = 'AUS' THEN 'AUD' WHEN ti.CountryCode = 'NZL' THEN 'NZD' ELSE 'NA' END AS CURRENCY_CODE, NULL AS CARD_EXPIRATION_DATE, NULL AS AUTHORIZED_FLAG, 'False' AS VOIDED_FLAG, ti.CashOutAmount AS CASH_BACK_AMOUNT, NULL AS PAYMENT_GATEWAY, NULL AS AUTHORIZATION_CODE, NULL AS SETTLEMENT_ID, NULL AS CARD_TYPE, NULL AS CARD_NUMBER, NULL AS CARDHOLDER_NAME, NULL AS BIN, NULL AS CARD_NUMBER_LAST4, NULL AS AVS_CHECK, NULL AS CVV_CHECK, NULL AS ELECTRONIC_RECEIPT, NULL AS ELECTRONIC_TYPE, NULL AS STATUS, NULL AS GIFT_BALANCE, GETDATE() AS UPDATED_DATE_TIME FROM inv ti WHERE ti.AccountAmount <> 0 UNION ALL SELECT CONVERT(varchar(50), ti.InvoiceID) + 'T' + 'C0' AS ID, ti.InvoiceID AS ORDER_ID, 0 AS SEQUENCE, 'CHEQUE' AS [TYPE], ISNULL(ti.ChequeAmount, 0) AS AMOUNT, CASE WHEN ti.CountryCode = 'AUS' THEN 'AUD' WHEN ti.CountryCode = 'NZL' THEN 'NZD' ELSE 'NA' END AS CURRENCY_CODE, NULL AS CARD_EXPIRATION_DATE, NULL AS AUTHORIZED_FLAG, 'False' AS VOIDED_FLAG, ti.CashOutAmount AS CASH_BACK_AMOUNT, NULL AS PAYMENT_GATEWAY, NULL AS AUTHORIZATION_CODE, NULL AS SETTLEMENT_ID, NULL AS CARD_TYPE, NULL AS CARD_NUMBER, NULL AS CARDHOLDER_NAME, NULL AS BIN, NULL AS CARD_NUMBER_LAST4, NULL AS AVS_CHECK, NULL AS CVV_CHECK, NULL AS ELECTRONIC_RECEIPT, NULL AS ELECTRONIC_TYPE, NULL AS STATUS, NULL AS GIFT_BALANCE, GETDATE() AS UPDATED_DATE_TIME FROM inv ti WHERE ti.ChequeAmount <> 0;

TableList.mergeKeyPredicate: t.EVENT_ID = s.EVENT_ID AND t.MYCHEM_ID = s.MYCHEM_ID AND t.QUANTITY = s.QUANTITY AND t.RETURN_FLAG = s.RETURN_FLAG AND t.PURCHASE_FLAG = s.PURCHASE_FLAG AND t.SEQUENCE IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.SEQUENCE
TableList.customQuery: SELECT t.InvoiceID AS ID, t.InvoiceID AS ORDER_ID, CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), t.InvoiceID) + 'E1' AS EVENT_ID, t.SaleRowNumber AS SEQUENCE, CASE WHEN t.TransactionType = 4 THEN -1 ELSE ISNULL(t.MychemID, t.Barcode) END AS SKU, t.Barcode AS UPC, CASE WHEN t.TransactionType = 4 THEN 'Rounding' ELSE ISNULL(t.unlisteddescription, p.PRODUCT_DESC) END AS DESCRIPTION, p.[GROUP] AS DEPARTMENT, t.QtySupplied AS QUANTITY, t.BaseUnitPriceEx AS AMOUNT, ISNULL(t.UnitGSTAmount * t.QtySupplied, 0) AS TAX_AMOUNT, t.BaseUnitPriceEx AS LIST_AMOUNT, CASE WHEN p.ServiceItem = 1 THEN 'SERVICE' ELSE 'PRODUCT' END AS TYPE, CASE WHEN t.Barcode IS NOT NULL THEN 'SCAN' ELSE 'KEY' END AS ENTRY_MODE, 'EACH' AS UNIT_OF_MEASURE, CASE WHEN t.QtySupplied = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS VOIDED_FLAG, CASE WHEN t.QtySupplied < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS RETURN_FLAG, CASE WHEN t.QtySupplied > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS PURCHASE_FLAG, CASE WHEN ABS(t.UnitPriceEx - t.BaseUnitPriceEx) > 0.001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS MANUAL_PRICE_FLAG, CASE WHEN t.UnitGSTAmount = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS TAX_EXEMPT_FLAG, p.CATEGORY AS MERCHANDISE_TYPE, CASE WHEN t.TransactionType = 4 THEN -1 ELSE ISNULL(t.MychemID, t.Barcode) END AS MYCHEM_ID, t.TransactionType AS TRANSACTION_TYPE, NULL AS SUPPLIER_ID, t.MultiBuyID AS MULTIBUY_ID, t.QtySupplied AS ORIGINAL_QUANTITY_SUPPLIED, GETDATE() AS UPDATED_DATE_TIME FROM dbo.Transactions t WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN dbo.BranchInfoGlobal bi ON t.OriginBranchID = bi.BranchID INNER JOIN dbo.BranchInfoHierarchy bih ON bih.BranchID = bi.BranchID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.dim_product p ON t.MychemID = p.MYCHEM_ID WHERE ((bih.ShopFrontType <> 'Epharmacy' AND bih.ShopFrontType <> 'Exclude' OR bih.ShopFrontType IS NULL) AND bi.BranchID NOT IN (663, 723) AND bi.StoreGroupID <> 0 AND bi.Storename NOT LIKE '%test%' AND bi.Storename NOT LIKE N'(DO NOT USE)%' AND bih.Exclude <> 1 AND bih.OpeningDate IS NOT NULL) AND t.inTimeStamp >= DATEADD(DAY, -2, '{{LoadDate}}') AND t.inTimeStamp < DATEADD(DAY, -1, '{{LoadDate}}') AND ?AdfDynamicRangePartitionCondition;
TableList.dedupePartitionBy: EVENT_ID, MYCHEM_ID, QUANTITY, RETURN_FLAG, PURCHASE_FLAG, SEQUENCE

TableList.mergeKeyPredicate: t.ORDER_ID = s.ORDER_ID AND t.ITEM_ID = s.ITEM_ID AND EQUAL_NULL(t.MULTIBUY_ID, s.MULTIBUY_ID)
TableList.customQuery: SELECT CONVERT(varchar(50), CASE WHEN t.TransactionType = 4 THEN -1 ELSE ISNULL(t.MychemID, t.Barcode) END) + '_D1' AS ID, CONVERT(varchar(50), CASE WHEN t.TransactionType = 4 THEN -1 ELSE ISNULL(t.MychemID, t.Barcode) END) AS ITEM_ID, t.InvoiceID AS ORDER_ID, CONVERT(varchar(20), t.InvoiceID) + 'E1' AS EVENT_ID, 'OTHER' AS TYPE, SUM(t.Total) AS AMOUNT, 'DISCOUNT' AS CODE, 'LINE' AS CLASSIFICATION, 'Amount' AS METHOD, 'False' AS VOIDED_FLAG, SUM(ROUND(ISNULL((t.BaseUnitPriceEx - t.UnitPriceEx) * t.QtySupplied, 0), 2)) AS DISCOUNT_AMOUNT, t.MultiBuyID AS MULTIBUY_ID, GETDATE() AS UPDATED_DATE_TIME FROM Transactions t WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN BranchInfoGlobal bi ON t.OriginBranchID = bi.BranchID INNER JOIN BranchInfoHierarchy bih ON bih.BranchID = bi.BranchID LEFT OUTER JOIN dim_product p ON t.MychemID = p.MYCHEM_ID WHERE ((bih.ShopFrontType <> 'Epharmacy' AND bih.ShopFrontType <> 'Exclude' OR bih.ShopFrontType IS NULL) AND bi.BranchID NOT IN (663, 723) AND bi.StoreGroupID <> 0 AND bi.Storename NOT LIKE '%test%' AND bi.Storename NOT LIKE N'(DO NOT USE)%' AND bih.Exclude <> 1 AND bih.OpeningDate IS NOT NULL) AND ABS(t.UnitPriceEx - t.BaseUnitPriceEx) > 0.001  AND t.inTimeStamp >= DATEADD(DAY,-2,'{{LoadDate}}') AND t.inTimeStamp < DATEADD(DAY,-1,'{{LoadDate}}') GROUP BY t.InvoiceID, CONVERT(varchar(50), CASE WHEN t.TransactionType = 4 THEN -1 ELSE ISNULL(t.MychemID, t.Barcode) END), t.MultiBuyID;

TableList.mergeKeyPredicate: t.ARTICLE_ID = s.ARTICLE_ID AND t.COUNTRY_CODE = s.COUNTRY_CODE AND (t.UPC = s.UPC OR (t.UPC IS NULL AND s.UPC IS NULL))
TableList.customQuery: SELECT p.MychemID AS ARTICLE_ID, 'AUS' AS COUNTRY_CODE, p.Description AS NAME, 'PRODUCT' AS PRODUCT_TYPE, b.BcodeStr AS UPC, p.Description AS RECEIPT_DESCRIPTION, dp.Category AS CATEGORY, dp.[GROUP] AS PRODUCT_GROUP, CASE p.Inactive WHEN 0 THEN 'True' ELSE 'False' END AS ACTIVE, CASE p.GSTout WHEN 1 THEN 'True' ELSE 'False' END AS IS_TAXABLE, 'False' AS IS_AGE_RESTRICTED, p.LockiePLU AS PLU, GETDATE() AS UPDATED_DATE_TIME FROM dbo.Products p JOIN dbo.dim_product dp ON p.MychemID = dp.MYCHEM_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT MychemID AS B_MYCHEMID, BcodeStr FROM dbo.Barcodes) b ON p.MychemID = b.B_MYCHEMID WHERE p.LastUpdated >= DATEADD(day,-900,'{{LoadDate}}') AND p.LastUpdated < DATEADD(day,-1,'{{LoadDate}}') UNION ALL SELECT p.MychemID AS ARTICLE_ID, 'NZL' AS COUNTRY_CODE, p.Description AS NAME, 'PRODUCT' AS PRODUCT_TYPE, b.BcodeStr AS UPC, p.Description AS RECEIPT_DESCRIPTION, dp.Category AS CATEGORY, dp.[GROUP] AS PRODUCT_GROUP, CASE p.Inactive WHEN 0 THEN 'True' ELSE 'False' END AS ACTIVE, CASE p.GSTout WHEN 1 THEN 'True' ELSE 'False' END AS IS_TAXABLE, 'False' AS IS_AGE_RESTRICTED, p.LockiePLU AS PLU, GETDATE() AS UPDATED_DATE_TIME FROM dbo.Products_NZL p JOIN dbo.dim_product_NZL dp ON p.MychemID = dp.MYCHEM_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT MychemID AS B_MYCHEMID, BcodeStr FROM dbo.Barcodes_NZL) b ON p.MychemID = b.B_MYCHEMID WHERE p.LastUpdated >= DATEADD(day,-900,'{{LoadDate}}') AND p.LastUpdated < DATEADD(day,-1,'{{LoadDate}}');

SELECT b.BranchID AS LOCATION_ID, 'STORE' AS LOCATION_TYPE, s.GroupName AS BRAND, b.StoreName AS NAME, b.Address AS ADDRESS1, b.LocationInfo AS ADDRESS2, b.Suburb AS CITY, CASE WHEN b.CountryCode = 'NZL' THEN b.Suburb ELSE b.State END AS STATE, b.Postcode AS POSTAL_CODE, b.CountryCode AS COUNTRY_CODE, b.Phone AS PHONE_NUMBER, b.Email AS EMAIL_ADDRESS, CASE WHEN b.StoreName LIKE '%DO NOT USE%' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS ACTIVE, GETDATE() AS UPDATED_DATE_TIME FROM dbo.BranchInfoGlobal b WITH (NOLOCK) JOIN dbo.StoreGroup s WITH (NOLOCK) ON b.StoreGroupID = s.StoreGroupId WHERE b.StoreName NOT LIKE '%test%' AND s.StoreGroupId NOT IN (4, 5);

SELECT ta.SaleactivitylogID AS SALEACTIVITYLOGID, ta.InvoiceID AS INVOICEID, ta.activityID AS ACTIVITYID, sad.description AS ACTIVITY_DESCRIPTION, ta.AdditionalDescription AS ADDITIONALDESCRIPTION, ta.TimeStamp AS DATE_TIME, GETDATE() AS UPDATED_DATE_TIME, ta.originbranchid AS STORE_ID, ta.EnteredBy AS STAFF_ID, ta.originbranchid AS STORE_NUMBER, ta.MachineName AS MACHINENAME FROM TransactionAuditSaleActivityLoghistory ta WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN BranchInfoGlobal bi ON ta.OriginBranchID = bi.BranchID INNER JOIN BranchInfoHierarchy bih ON bih.BranchID = bi.BranchID INNER JOIN saleactivitydefinitions sad ON ta.activityid = sad.saleactivityid WHERE ((bih.ShopFrontType <> 'Epharmacy' AND bih.ShopFrontType <> 'Exclude' OR bih.ShopFrontType IS NULL) AND bi.BranchID NOT IN (663, 723) AND bi.StoreGroupID <> 0 AND bi.Storename NOT LIKE '%test%' AND bi.Storename NOT LIKE N'(DO NOT USE)%' AND bih.Exclude <> 1 AND bih.OpeningDate IS NOT NULL) AND ta.TimeStamp >= DATEADD(day, -2, '{{LoadDate}}') AND ta.TimeStamp < DATEADD(day, -1, '{{LoadDate}}') AND ?AdfDynamicRangePartitionCondition;

SELECT [StaffID] AS EMPLOYEE_ID, [StaffID] AS STAFF_ID, [FirstName] AS FIRST_NAME, [LastName] AS LAST_NAME, CONCAT(FirstName,' ',LastName) AS FULL_NAME, [Active] AS [STATUS], [LastUpdated] AS CREATED_AT, GETDATE() AS UPDATED_DATE_TIME FROM [StoreStaffDetails] WHERE FirstName IS NOT NULL;
